FN-JVASYY-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 250
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 05/08/2023
Senate Bill 250 as introduced could increase the obligations of local boards of education by an
undetermined amount to pay any fines, fees, or other penalties charged by the athletic
association to a student or parent of a student for violating the eligibility policies of the athletic
association. This bill will not otherwise affect state of local funding.
